name: omdb-api-manager-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker version of an OMDb multi-key API manager.

CLIENT_KEYS.description: Client access keys for callers. Supports newline, comma, or space separated values.

OMDB_KEYS.description: Upstream OMDb API key pool. Supports newline, comma, or space separated values. Do not commit real keys.

STATS_KV.description: Optional KV namespace binding. When configured, /metrics request counters are persisted.
